results.criterion: The site is one HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript, needs no build step, and names Ananya Rao and Jaipur.
results.note: Mechanical check: 20140 bytes, 0 external resources, no JS errors. The code has inline <style> and <script> tags, and the title and h1 read 'Ananya Rao' and 'Wedding Photographer, Jaipur'.

results.criterion: A gallery section renders multiple images from one editable list, and each image is visibly labelled as a placeholder.
results.note: GALLERY has 8 entries, all with placeholder:true. The render loop adds a visible 'Placeholder' badge to each tile. Mechanical check shows no overflow at 360px or 1280px.

results.criterion: A testimonials section renders from one editable list, and each testimonial carries a visible 'sample' label.
results.note: TESTIMONIALS has 3 entries with sample:true. The render loop adds a 'Sample' badge to each blockquote, and the quote text and author are also marked as samples.

results.criterion: An enquiry form has a wedding date field, a name field and a contact field, validates them before submit, and shows a confirmation message after a valid submit.
results.note: The form has novalidate and fields #name, #contact and #date. validate() runs before the fetch, with per-field errors covering empty, short name, bad contact, past date and non-existent date. A valid submit shows #confirm, with a draft line when the endpoint is unset. I read the code and did not run submit paths; the mechanical check only covers overflow, errors and links.

results.criterion: The form's delivery endpoint is one named placeholder constant, and the page shows a visible note that enquiries are not delivered until it is set.
results.note: const ENQUIRY_ENDPOINT = "PLACEHOLDER_SET_ENQUIRY_ENDPOINT" is the single constant. #endpoint-note is visible while it is unset. Warning: the top banner line 'Launch blocker: ... enquiries are not delivered yet' is static HTML and stays after the endpoint is set, so it would then be false.

extra_issues.criterion: Brief and charter statement: packages and prices section, with prices labelled 'sample, replace before launch'
extra_issues.note: The site has no packages or prices section. It has only Gallery, Testimonials and Enquiry in the nav and main. The item was moved to open_inputs and is unbuilt. Budget is 35 of 40 against a 10 cost, and Adaptation's request for a ruling (a) or (b) has no recorded answer.
